title: DeepResearchOutput
description: JSON envelope emitted by the `deep-research` subcommand. Hand-maintained from `src/deep_research.rs::DeepResearchOutput`. The Rust type is the source of truth. v0.8.7 (GAP-WS-087/088) added `query` and the `results[].title` rename; v0.8.9 (GAP-WS-105) added news fields; v0.9.8 (GAP-WS-AGENT-READY-001 / ADR-0018) added agent metadata `used_chrome`, `chrome_path_resolved`, `chrome_channel` on metadata (not telemetry). Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize. GAP-SCHEMA-DEEP closed: metadata includes partial/sub_queries_*/chrome_contention_advisory/total_time_ms.

query.description: v0.8.7+ (GAP-WS-088): Original user query, mirroring `SearchOutput.query` for schema parity.

metadata.description: Run-level metadata: original query, per-sub-query outcomes, aggregation strategy, unique counts, total latency, cascade level.

results.description: Aggregated web evidence list, sorted by descending score (RRF or dedupe-by-url).

news.description: v0.8.9+ (GAP-WS-105): Aggregated news list. ALWAYS serialized — empty when zero news items were found or when --no-news was passed. News RRF scores live in their OWN score space and are NOT comparable with results[].score.

news_count.description: v0.8.9+ (GAP-WS-105): Number of aggregated news items. ALWAYS serialized (0 with --no-news or zero news). The process exits 0 when EITHER vertical produced results; exit 5 only when web AND news are both empty.

synthesis.description: Optional synthesised report, present only with --synthesize (skip_serializing_if). Wire key is synthesis (PT alias sintese). v0.8.9+ (GAP-WS-105): with news items present the report is dual-section, splitting --budget-tokens ~70% web / ~30% news.

unique_result_count.description: Number of unique web results after deduplication / RRF.

unique_news_count.description: v0.8.9+ (GAP-WS-105): Number of unique news items after news aggregation (parity with total_results_unicos). ALWAYS present (0 with --no-news).

total_time_ms.description: End-to-end wall-clock duration in milliseconds (wire key total_time_ms; PT alias tempo_total_ms on deserialize).

cascade_level.description: Anti-bot cascade level reached during the deepest sub-query (0..=4). Null when no cascade was triggered.

used_chrome.description: v0.9.8 agent contract (not telemetry): honest true when a Chrome/Chromium session was used for this deep-research run.

chrome_path_resolved.description: v0.9.8 agent contract (not telemetry): resolved Chrome/Chromium binary path after shell/Flatpak resolution.

chrome_channel.description: v0.9.8+ agent contract (not telemetry): install channel of the resolved browser (no env channel).

sub_queries_total.description: v1.0.2 agent-native partial surface: total sub-queries dispatched.

sub_queries_error.description: v1.0.2: sub-queries that failed (EN wire; PT alias sub_queries_erro on deserialize).

partial.description: v1.0.2: true when any sub-query failed or status != ok (partial harvest; PT alias parcial on deserialize).

chrome_contention_advisory.description: v1.0.2: advisory true when host Chrome process count suggests contention. Omitted when false (skip_serializing_if).

text.description: The sub-query text (EN wire key; PT alias texto on deserialize).

strategy.description: Origin label — heuristic, manual, or a template name.

status.description: ok when results were produced, error otherwise (EN default). With --wire-keys pt the value is erro.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock duration for this sub-query in milliseconds.

error_message.description: Error message. Present only when status == error (skip_serializing_if).

news_count.description: Number of news items returned by this sub-query news scan. ABSENT when --no-news or unavailable.

news_unavailable.description: true when news scan expected but unavailable mid-flight. Omitted otherwise.

news_error.description: Short news failure code when news_unavailable is true.

url.description: Source URL as returned by the upstream search. Deduplication uses the blake3 hash of the canonicalized URL.

title.description: v0.8.7+ (GAP-WS-087): Title (serde rename of the Rust field `title`). First non-empty across duplicates is kept.

display_url.description: Display URL, kept from the first occurrence. Absent when not available (skip_serializing_if).

snippet.description: Snippet, first non-empty across duplicates. Absent when not available (skip_serializing_if).

score.description: Web-list score in [0.0, 1.0] (RRF sum normalized, or 1.0 for dedupe-by-url). Higher is better. NOT comparable with news[].score.

position.description: Original 1-indexed position in the source sub-query.

sources.description: Texts of the sub-queries that produced this result.

position.description: 1-indexed position in the aggregated news list, reassigned after the merge.

title.description: Headline, kept from the most recent exemplar across duplicates.

url.description: Article URL as returned by the upstream search. Deduped by canonical-URL blake3 hash.

source.description: Publisher/source name, kept from the most recent exemplar. Absent when not extractable (skip_serializing_if).

relative_date.description: Relative timestamp verbatim (e.g. 'há 2 horas', '3 hours ago'), kept from the most recent exemplar. Used for the recency tiebreak via relative_date_to_minutes. Absent when not extractable (skip_serializing_if).

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail URL, kept from the most recent exemplar. Absent when not extractable (skip_serializing_if).

score.description: News-only RRF score (RRF sum, or 1.0 for dedupe-by-url). Higher is better. Computed in a SEPARATE score space — NEVER comparable with results[].score (RRF scores over distinct lists are incomparable).

occurrences.description: Number of sub-queries in which this news item appeared.

SynthesizedReport.description: Corrected 2026-08-22: this $def declared the four PT alias spellings as if they were the wire keys, while src/synthesis/mod.rs has emitted the English names since the v1.0.2 EN wire default (ADR-0027). Every other $def in this file was already English. An agent that did the right thing — read the schema instead of guessing — was sent to .synthesis.corpo and read null, with no error and no exit code. The PT spellings remain deserialization aliases and are still emitted under --wire-keys pt.

format.description: Format used to render the report (--synth-format; serde snake_case of SynthFormat). Legacy PT alias: formato.

body.description: The report body (Markdown, PlainText, or JSON tree serialized as string). Legacy PT alias: corpo.

estimated_tokens.description: Approximate token count of the report body (4 chars ≈ 1 token). Bounded by --budget-tokens. Legacy PT alias: tokens_estimados.

reference_count.description: Number of references cited in the report. Legacy PT alias: quantidade_referencias.
